quotes.speaker: Mitch Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitch Johnson on how Spurs analyze and document defensive schemes
quotes.excerpt: we have to because it's difficult at times to sometimes have continuity game to game
quotes.quote: We have to because it's difficult at times to sometimes have continuity game to game when it's such a different game in terms of what teams are trying to take away or how they guard you. And that can be matchups, that can be schemes, that can be coverages. So something that happened in the last game may not show itself tonight, whether it helped us or hurt us, and that may just be personnel-driven or how they play.
quotes.social_post: Mitch Johnson explains why the Spurs prioritize documenting defensive schemes game to game because of how much personnel and coverage styles change across the league

structured.context: Mitch Johnson explains the challenges of maintaining defensive continuity due to varying opponent schemes and personnel.

quotes.speaker: Mitch Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitch Johnson on Victor Wembanyama's unique defensive versatility
quotes.excerpt: Victor is the most unique puzzle piece as I like to say a lot
quotes.quote: I think obviously Victor is the most unique puzzle piece as I like to say a lot, but we do see a lot. And it's funny like the start of the year, Steph was getting guarded by centers or bigger players, and we hadn't talked a lot about it. Now we saw it a ton in Portland last year in the playoffs, we saw it in Minnesota in the playoffs, we saw it a little bit in Oklahoma City in the playoffs, we saw it throughout last year, but we hadn't talked a lot in training camp and came out and Oklahoma City did it and Houston did it.
quotes.social_post: Mitch Johnson calls Victor Wembanyama the most unique puzzle piece in the league and notes how teams are increasingly using bigger players to guard perimeter threats like Steph Curry

structured.context: Mitch Johnson discusses Victor Wembanyama's unique defensive role and how teams are adjusting their defensive strategies against him.

quotes.speaker: Mitch Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitch Johnson on Carter's aggressive shooting and confidence
quotes.excerpt: I'd much rather them be confident and be aggressive to shoot than to not or to hesitate
quotes.quote: Carter is a good shooter, especially when his feet are set, his shoulders are square, and he catches it in rhythm. I want him to be aggressive. If I'm being brutally honest, which I am, I don't want him to shoot all the shots he's taking, but I'd much rather them be confident and be aggressive to shoot than to not or to hesitate. That's what comes with the young players sometimes that are still figuring out their ways. It's not going to be perfect.
quotes.social_post: Mitch Johnson says he wants Carter to be aggressive with his shot but admits he does not want him to take every shot he currently puts up as he continues to develop

structured.context: Mitch Johnson discusses his expectations for Carter's shooting confidence and decision-making on the court.

quotes.speaker: Mitch Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitch Johnson on Dylan's recovery and return timeline
quotes.excerpt: he's feeling better than he did the night of the Detroit game and the day after
quotes.quote: He's feeling better than he did the night of the Detroit game and the day after for sure. It's very, very, very best-case scenario. We are very fortunate in terms of just the way it looked. I really didn't like how it looked, I didn't feel good about it and it was 24 hours where you were just kind of crossing your fingers and hoping for the best, and it was the best. So I think we're just going to have to see what it looks like, but it's positive.
quotes.social_post: Mitch Johnson provides a positive update on Dylan following his injury against Detroit saying the team is very fortunate after fearing the worst when it happened

structured.context: Mitch Johnson provides an update on Dylan's injury status following the game against the Detroit Pistons.
